svg.aria-label: Claude · index on top memory mechanism diagram. One Claude card covers both surfaces. Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md every session, injects only the first 200 lines or 25 KB of MEMORY.md as an index, and leaves topic notes on disk until they are read on demand. Session transcripts remain the ground truth that notes are checked against. Claude Desktop keeps the same index-and-topic layout for Space, agent, and account topics; account Chat and cloud project memory stay server-side and reach dachshund only over MCP.
